final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The change is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes the title (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before passing it to the slugifier.

I didn't touch `vendor/slugify`. Its header and `vendor/README.md` say that folder is replaced wholesale by the platform team, so a local edit would be lost on the next upgrade.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also uses the vendored slugifier, so product URLs still drop accents the same way. I left that alone since it's outside this task. If you want it fixed too, the same normalization would work there.
